beats.operation: Let walking, pause and bodily absence carry duration before restoration becomes an action goal.
beats.gap: Preserve red/black costume, sunglasses and hidden hands with original performance.

beats.title: Ravens over debris and footprints

a.title: Mother Mack Trains Her Seven Puppies

beats.edit: Move between tracks, bird and shore at three scales; they form a route only through their succession.
beats.operation: Use a track only if following it discloses the missing situation; birds can acquire relations through recurrence.
beats.gap: Ravens, tracks and shoreline can be separate inserts.

beats.title: Heart floats from shore into Poet
beats.edit: Place a luminous heart reference near the figure's chest as an openly provisional composite; then remove the insert border in production.
beats.operation: Test the heart as charged partial object; seed/environment requires reciprocal crystallisation, not simply restoration.
beats.gap: Heart and re-entry require VFX; medical imagery is only object reference.

beats.title: Follow a trail uphill toward the field
beats.edit: Follow the ridge line into the first plant detail; preserve a clear directional cue across the scale change.
beats.operation: Assemble partial paths into a rigorous trajectory; keep the actor’s relation to scale explicit.
beats.gap: Match screen direction, light and costume across landscape plates.

beats.title: Golden plants turn toward Poet; weeds withdraw
beats.edit: Repeat plant closeups in progressively brighter fields; later flower gathering recalls this first responsive world.
beats.operation: Make the environment respond and transform; use seed/environment only if the reciprocal virtual relation is developed.
beats.gap: Responsive golden plants and retreating weeds need animation or effects.

beats.title: Clouds extinguish the stars
beats.edit: Return to the cloud field with a longer hold; test whether weather interrupts the route instead of merely illustrating mood.
beats.operation: Remove visual coordinates while sound holds the scene; darkness alone proves neither sign.
beats.gap: Night sky plate plus sonic design.

beats.title: Search bare ground for lost hands
beats.edit: Center the hand/soil reference while the wider world recedes. Keep the actual Poet's hands withheld until the next unit.
beats.operation: Let searching actions reveal the absent part; distinguish a bodily partial object from ordinary found-object symbolism.
beats.gap: Detached hands and performer continuity require effects.

beats.title: Hands restored; Poet stands reflecting
beats.edit: Reveal the hand material in an uncluttered full frame; this must eventually be the same performer's hands.
beats.operation: Hold posture after restoration; distinguish thought through bodily attitude from a causal trace that drives another act.
beats.gap: Shoot the reattachment and the quiet aftermath separately.

beats.title: Ancestral parade receives Poet
beats.edit: Build procession from wide crowd, distinct face, collective gesture; never treat found people as authenticated fictional ancestors.
beats.operation: Keep collective feeling and distinct attitudes visible; gest asks how the arrangement articulates social relations.
beats.gap: Historical community footage cannot be claimed to depict these named fictional ancestors.

beats.title: Ancestors offer stars and galaxies
beats.edit: Keep ceremonial bodies beside cosmic fields; the relation should be offered as the Poet's construction, not documentary equivalence.
beats.operation: Treat the cosmic gift as an excessive project or a seed of a world; the relation must be constructed in the edit.
beats.gap: Afrofuturist figures, gifts and universe objects require original design and composites.

beats.title: Childhood basement, shared mattress, southern wood

a.title: Anatomy Of An Ancient Barn 6 - Rafters - (Wide Screen 16:9)

b.title: [Amateur films: Ivan Besse collection: Britton, South Dakota 1938-39] (Part I)

beats.edit: Return to an interior childhood reference through the earlier car-memory texture; preserve uncertainty about its causal force.
beats.operation: Locate an inherited social milieu and return to it as an uncertain recollection.
beats.gap: Optional poem-column insert; do not manufacture a biographical archival claim.

beats.title: Blood and fingerprints carry ancestral power
beats.edit: Enlarge skin or fingerprint texture over the restored hands; lineage is a proposed poetic relation, not a biological claim about pictured people.
beats.operation: Link hand, genealogy and world as a thought relation; scientific diagrams alone are not cinema of the brain.
beats.gap: Optional poem-column insert; body effects and genealogy need authored linkage.

beats.title: Winged marble gates open
beats.edit: Introduce the gates as a full architectural threshold; withhold the city until the entrance has registered.
beats.operation: Let a material threshold figure a larger world; distinguish figurative enlargement from mere monumental scale.
beats.gap: Atlantis gate is a designed composite.

beats.title: Candlelit narrow streets, welcoming faces

a.title: Parents of Music Students Holly Jolly Trolley Tour 12/13/14

beats.edit: Travel through night street, elevated view and street again; use changes of center rather than an uninterrupted implied point of view.
beats.operation: Establish the city then allow perception to migrate among residents; a moving camera alone is not liquid perception.
beats.gap: Use original Mexico City wandering footage where specified in the treatment.

beats.title: Voiceover stops; wander toward a house
beats.edit: Hold the house exterior after the street montage. A voice pause must be deliberately mixed; the existing suite audio is preserved here.
beats.operation: Let sight and ambient sound continue after explanatory voice withdraws; withholding voice alone does not prove the break.
beats.gap: Needs an actual sound edit, not merely a mute visual plate.

beats.title: DJ appears, spins and scratches

a.title: Have I Told You Lately That I Love You?

beats.edit: Start on the turntable as a small mechanism inside the performance field; expand the crowd only after the record is established.
beats.operation: Connect staged performance to lived action; alternatively release scratching into a pure sonic situation.
beats.gap: Original part-one bar footage is an explicit source anchor; archive turntables are inserts.

beats.title: Poet performs; audience responds
beats.edit: Alternate performer-space references and listening bodies; original poetry-reading video should replace the proxy at this position.
beats.operation: Alternate affective face, collective response and social gest without treating them as interchangeable.
beats.gap: The Poet’s own performance is required; archive audiences are comparative or composite material.

beats.title: Bands diverge; home splits; eleven petals

b.title: Belmont Historical Society Presents: Richard Betts Remembers 01/05/06

beats.edit: Three deliberately separate inserts: ring, home, petals. Treat this as an optional poem montage, not extra plot events.
beats.operation: Build object relations across repeated departures; establish a series before claiming its interruption.
beats.gap: Optional poem-column montage; diverging rings and split homes need editorial construction.

beats.title: Rooftop club, strobe, shifted time
beats.edit: Move from overhead dancers to rooftop geography; join by crowd rhythm when moving clips become available.
beats.operation: Let separate bodily intensities persist within the crowd; pleasure alone does not establish impulse.
beats.gap: Rooftop setting and named performers need original work; speed changes are an edit decision.

beats.title: Soul leaves body and watches from above
beats.edit: Let a spectral-body image drift over the city field; the double remains distinguishable before its return.
beats.operation: Make actual body and virtual double exchange perceptual authority; a ghost effect alone is insufficient.
beats.gap: Soul/body separation requires matched performer plates.

beats.title: Overhead Atlantis, blue and pink lights
beats.edit: Give the aerial a full-frame interval after the split body; it is a change of scale, not automatically a gaze.
beats.operation: Let the city operate as the thinking field of the split body; aerial scale alone is not cerebral topology.
beats.gap: Colour grade and city composite needed.

beats.title: Angels pour cleansing water over dancing body
beats.edit: Water and aerial occupy adjacent panels; the missing angels remain an explicit compositing task.
beats.operation: Make the cleansing a ritual relation among bodies; primal force requires more than a water effect.
beats.gap: Angels and in-club pouring require staged inserts or VFX.

beats.title: Haze inhaled; soul returns
beats.edit: Dissolve the city/soul texture back into the dance field using the same party reference as the departure.
beats.operation: Reverse the relation of bodily presence and virtual double; ordinary smoke does not demonstrate the crystal.
beats.gap: Matched soul/body composite and breath action required.

beats.title: Rooftop gaze toward distant mountains
beats.edit: Hold rooftop edge and mountain skyline together where possible; avoid substituting a skyline for the required shared geography.
beats.operation: Hold looking without immediate practical response; smallness against the view is only a secondary possibility.
beats.gap: Match rooftop and mountains through location choice or compositing.

beats.title: Crowds admire Poet; Ex appears and is unreachable
beats.edit: Repeat crowd and pursuit fragments from the party; a recognizable Ex requires original back-facing footage.
beats.operation: Use the repeated back to support recognition and misrecognition; follow the fragmented pursuit.
beats.gap: Ex remains back-only; admirers need performance continuity.

beats.title: Poet and Ex walk under the moon
beats.edit: Compare footwork reference and dance crowd; this tests rhythm only, with moonwalk still an unfilled performance need.
beats.operation: Allow conversation to stretch remembered time; incompatible presents need more than a long implied duration.
beats.gap: No literal aging: preserve the treatment’s explicit instruction.

beats.title: Suitcases, phone booth, call to Mother
beats.edit: Let the phone booth interrupt the crowd. Hold the receiver before cutting to any interlocutor reference.
beats.operation: Make departure a question staged around phone and luggage; objects gather relations through use.
beats.gap: Performer, mother’s voice and suitcase continuity require original footage.

beats.title: Mother and Poet watch Poet and Ex break up

b.title: [Amateur films: Ivan Besse collection: Britton, South Dakota 1938-39] (Part II)

beats.edit: Two spaces coexist: witnesses and the earlier breakup. Use split-screen so neither panel falsely becomes a settled flashback.
beats.operation: Keep the same Poet in two simultaneous positions; peaks require the presents to remain incompatible, not simply a framed flashback.
beats.gap: Composite foreground conversation and background breakup.

beats.title: Street becomes living room; breakup remains

a.title: [Amateur films: Ivan Besse collection: Britton, South Dakota 1938-39] (Part II)

beats.edit: Insert the bedroom/living-room field into the street, then enlarge it; this is a spatial collage of the breakup.
beats.operation: Change the surrounding temporal region while the breakup persists; determine whether this is past coexistence or actual/virtual exchange.
beats.gap: Location transformation is an authored compositing operation.

beats.title: Mother disappears; Father answers and appears
beats.edit: Return to the same phone-booth material, changing the voice relation rather than the visual location.
beats.operation: Let alternative family recollections reframe the breakup; forking paths is optional unless these pasts become incompatible.
beats.gap: Do not force forking paths onto complementary parental memories.

beats.title: Father and son walk while breakup persists

a.title: Bosque del Apache National Wildlife Refuge

b.title: [Amateur films: Ivan Besse collection: Britton, South Dakota 1938-39] (Part II)

beats.edit: Keep the walk and breakup alongside one another; a cutaway would imply a simpler recollection than this simultaneity.
beats.operation: Link inherited bodily attitudes while another temporal layer remains present.
beats.gap: Composite breakup layer with original father/son performance.

beats.title: Ex dissolves into haze
beats.edit: Let the receding-figure reference fade before the motorcycle appears; the exit becomes a threshold rather than an explained disappearance.
beats.operation: Let a recurring presence fail to recur as expected; exchange actual and virtual only if their circuit is sustained.
beats.gap: Back-only Ex dissolve needs a controlled plate.

beats.title: Poet touches steel and mounts motorcycle
beats.edit: Establish the motorcycle and rider scale; the same vehicle should anchor departure, travel and arrival.
beats.operation: The act discloses a possible new trajectory; fetish is conditional on the vehicle storing an impulse, not desire alone.
beats.gap: Use the treatment’s Mexico City motorcycle photographs as continuity anchor.

beats.title: Ride through Atlantis, buildings and lights streak

b.title: Parents of Music Students Holly Jolly Trolley Tour 12/13/14

beats.edit: Alternate rider and city at decreasing shot lengths, then open the rhythm for the mountain segment.
beats.operation: Bind road perception to the rider, then connect partial urban situations through the ride.
beats.gap: Need matching motorcycle/rider; archive traffic can supply rear-projection or montage plates.

beats.title: Noise blocks noise; heads turn
beats.edit: Briefly withhold the motorcycle image while the sound interval persists. This draft retains suite audio; isolated engine sound needs a later mix.
beats.operation: Establish the returning engine relation; a sonsign requires listening to detach from practical movement, not loudness alone.
beats.gap: Audition engines and street sound; sound remains unverified by posters.

beats.title: Leave city as night lightens

a.title: Space Shuttle: A Remarkable Flying Machine

b.title: Bosque del Apache National Wildlife Refuge

beats.edit: Bleed night-city light into pale mountain light; retain dawn as the provisional reading of the treatment's contradictory wording.
beats.operation: Break the recurring nocturnal series as the world changes register.
beats.gap: Treatment calls this dusk but describes approaching morning; use dawn as a provisional editorial reading.

beats.title: Mountain ride, birds and first light

a.title: Bosque del Apache National Wildlife Refuge

beats.edit: Return to the rider between landscape passages so geography and travel remain linked rather than becoming a scenic reel.
beats.operation: Continue the broken trajectory while birdsong may open an independent sonic duration.
beats.gap: Rider footage and birdsong need separate verification.

beats.title: Return to chapel shore and dismount

a.title: Mother Mack Trains Her Seven Puppies

beats.edit: Hold the vehicle arrival against the chapel recurrence; preserve the earlier architectural axis for recognition.
beats.operation: Return to an established place so past damage can determine present action; recurrence must be recognisable.
beats.gap: Match geography and vehicle rather than treating any coast as the same place.

beats.title: Fog drifts over undeveloped shoreline
beats.edit: Begin with fog and shore without a task. Delay the building material so seeing has time to exceed action.
beats.operation: Hold a pure optical and potentially sonic interval before rebuilding begins.
beats.gap: Image does not verify fog sound, sea sound or a sonsign.

beats.title: Modern white temple builds with Poet
beats.edit: Accumulate masonry, plan and finished facade; this draft tests construction rhythm rather than claiming the temple visibly self-builds.
beats.operation: Let a seed of the future environment and the surrounding world reciprocally realise one another.
beats.gap: Self-building temple needs VFX; construction footage is a process plate, not the finished effect.

beats.title: Journal becomes blueprint, words are spoken
beats.edit: Place the drawing inside the construction field; reciprocal scale changes propose seed/environment, not blueprint symbolism alone.
beats.operation: Make the spectator read the relation between written words and the built environment; visible text alone is insufficient.
beats.gap: Optional poem-column insert; exact journal and spoken words must be authored.

beats.title: Completed temple and Poet in sunlight
beats.edit: Hold the completed white structure after the incremental montage. Reuse its geometry in the final haze sequence.
beats.operation: Show the new milieu and the scale of ordinary maintenance after visionary construction.
beats.gap: Original temple design and matching performance required.

beats.edit: Gather individual and small-group portraits before the collective image; keep distinct intensities within the assembly.
beats.operation: Keep individual responses within collective feeling; repeated poses can articulate brotherhood as gest.
beats.gap: Re-enact the specified personal photographs rather than claim unrelated men are these friends.

beats.edit: Set photo and living-tableau references side by side; the user's actual archive photographs must supply identity and reenactment matches.
beats.operation: Turn a represented past into a staged present; recursion and sheets of past each require a further relation.
beats.gap: Personal source photos are named but not supplied; exact reenactments remain a production gap.

beats.title: Walk from temple along harbor to cafe
beats.edit: Establish café and harbor as one provisional geography before the looks toward couples.
beats.operation: Connect fragments into a legible yet open trajectory through the renewed milieu.
beats.gap: Preserve daylight and geography.

beats.title: Poet watches romantic couples
beats.edit: Alternate seated observer and paired walkers, preserving the direction of attention without inventing their relationship.
beats.operation: Alternate a privileged viewpoint with affect on the watcher’s face; looking and face intensity are distinct units.
beats.gap: Performer and desired relationships require original coverage.

beats.title: Couple beside water on Jupiter’s moon

beats.edit: Place the couple-reference field beside the impossible lunar landscape; the comparison stages displacement, not documentary location.
beats.operation: Extend the world as an implied dream without assigning it to a sleeping character.
beats.gap: Explicit B-roll idea; moon landscape and couple need a composite.

beats.title: People walk together beside harbor
beats.edit: Return from the impossible landscape to a sustained harbor walk; keep the return noticeably quieter in edit density.
beats.operation: Read ordinary companionship through its gestures; quotidian is conditional on the ordinary/enormous exchange.
beats.gap: B-roll can remain literal companionship without claiming a genetic sign.

beats.title: Older couple prays in church
beats.edit: Let paired bodies and stillness carry the prayer interval only as references; an actual older praying couple remains missing.
beats.operation: Link bodies through a social ceremony; avoid reducing prayer to a generic religious emblem.
beats.gap: Exact couple and church relation may require original coverage.

beats.title: Flowers harvested into Poet’s power
beats.edit: Return to the earlier plant motif, now joining hand and flower; the power becomes legible through the repeated relationship.
beats.operation: Transform material growth into a virtual capacity that reshapes the world; seed is not simply a botanical noun.
beats.gap: Flower-to-power transformation needs VFX and a developed reciprocal relation.

beats.edit: Repeat the café threshold with an exit emphasis; a reverse angle should resolve the observer's earlier position.
beats.operation: Let posture and fragmentary encounters continue without resolving the relational situation.
beats.gap: If the exit merely advances plot, body-attitude and small-form limit remain weak readings.

beats.title: Harbor, temple, Atlantis dissolve into haze
beats.edit: Carry haze over the completed temple and city; the same fog seen in the bedroom now acts at environmental scale.
beats.operation: Dissolve geographical distinctions across previously established places.
beats.gap: Matching city and temple dissolves require composite plates.

beats.title: Haze climbs reluctant Poet; float in black

a.title: [Amateur films: Ivan Besse collection: Britton, South Dakota 1938-39] (Part VII)

beats.edit: Recall the suspended body while the environment fades. Keep this recurrence visually recognizable, not merely another cloud plate.
beats.operation: Hold reluctance in bodily attitude as effective action gives way to the optical situation.
beats.gap: Performer and engulfing smoke need staged or composited work.

beats.title: Floating alternates with life’s highs and lows
beats.edit: Counterpose celebration and destruction, then return to a quiet face/body reference. Contradiction is editorial, not proof of falsifying narration.
beats.operation: Read the worlds against one another; powers of the false is only an optional experiment if no final truth hierarchy settles them.
beats.gap: The treatment specifies contrast, not necessarily falsifying narration; choose this consciously.

beats.title: Vintage door appears in black
beats.edit: Hold the vintage door before entry; repeat its framing at the final closure.
beats.operation: Let a material object reopen an entire world; symbol and movement-of-world can coexist.
beats.gap: Isolated door and black-space transition need a designed shot.

beats.title: Return to vintage party in slow motion
beats.edit: Return to the original party source so the loop is legible; mix in one changed fragment to resist simple repetition.
beats.operation: Recognise the returning party; forking paths requires an incompatible return, not simple repetition.
beats.gap: A divergent version is an optional cineotic experiment, not an instruction already in the treatment.

beats.title: Poet disappears into crowd; door closes
beats.edit: Let the party dissolve into the same door, then black. The Poet's disappearance and closing door need matched original action.
beats.operation: End by altering the earlier pattern of pursuit; make the closing door demand a reading of the whole circuit.
beats.gap: Use the same party/door geography and Poet costume continuity.
